links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting with instructions only (phase one baseline), same models and vignettes
links.outcome: Classification accuracy and consistency of ophthalmology referral triage into 16 symptom-based categories
links.effect: Mean accuracy across models rose from 68.7% to 73.4% after exposure to 957 labeled examples; ChatGPT 4o consistency rose from 66.8% to 93.8% with net improvement in 933 cases (p < 0.001); ChatGPT 5.1 peak accuracy 79.5%
links.tradeoff: Performance remained lower for rare or ambiguous referral categories; human oversight and further clinical validation still needed
links.quote: Baseline classification accuracy averaged 68.7% across models, improving to 73.4% post exposure.
